summary: AOSP is a comprehensive business transformation platform developed for AmeriCasa by Newton Vision Corporation. As a quality-focused developer, I played a key role in establishing development standards and leading the team to deliver an enterprise Angular application with significant business impact.

challenge.title: Establishing quality standards and leading a development team to deliver an enterprise Angular platform that drives measurable business growth.
challenge.description: Starting as a quality analyst, I identified inefficiencies in the development process and project management. The challenge was not just writing code, but creating a culture of excellence through proper GitHub workflows, automated testing, and peer review processes. Later tasked with leading the team, I needed to balance technical direction with team dynamics while delivering features that directly impacted business metrics—sales optimization and customer experience through accessibility and SEO.

solution.title: Leading the AOSP platform development with Angular, growing sales by 5% through optimized customer experience and improved web accessibility.
solution.description: I started as a quality analyst, implementing rigorous GitHub project management and code quality standards that elevated the entire team's output. My dedication earned a promotion to senior developer, where I led the team in architecting the AOSP platform with Angular. The frontend was built with scalability and user experience as primary concerns. I championed SEO optimization and web accessibility improvements on the landing page, resulting in better customer reviews and a 5% sales increase. Through consistent application of code quality tools like ESLint and Prettier, I ensured the codebase remained clean and maintainable. The project demonstrated how technical excellence and quality-first processes directly drive business outcomes.
